full_zh: 背景：Braintree 的费用平台跑在 Snowflake 上。Visa 和 Mastercard 能从收单方拿到近实时视图，但 Amex 是闭环网络，每天只丢一个定宽文件过来，所以文件确认结算之前，Amex 交易不能入账。因为这个限制，Amex 必须单独做一条管线。
问题：我接手时只有前任留下的一张表的 stub。我是这条管线从设计文档到生产的 owner，输出要喂给费用计算和出款，所以它一旦出错就会直接影响钱，必须从设计上就假定会出错。
我做了什么：每种记录类型一条 append-only stream，共六条，各有独立 offset，这样互相不阻塞；每个阶段用复合键 MERGE，这样重发文件或重跑任务都不会重复计数；两个校验函数把所有对不上的记录写进 error log 而不是丢掉；再用一个 feature flag 当 kill switch，一条 UPDATE 就能停，不用发版。
结果：我一直在 on-call，真实故障出现后又补了十几个加固 PR。前六个月处理了约 2200 万笔 Amex 交易，在生产跑了 18 个月，管线本身也是我任期内最大的 PR，约 1800 行。
为什么这样做 / 学到：钱的管线不可能假设不出错，所以我选择让它坏的时候留下记录而不是悄悄丢数据，这是我最自豪的设计。
full_en: The project I'm proudest of is the American Express settlement pipeline on our Snowflake-based fee platform at Braintree. Amex is a closed-loop network: instead of near-real-time views from our acquirer, it sends one fixed-width reconciliation file a day, so we can't book an Amex transaction until that file confirms it settled. I inherited a stub with a single table and owned the pipeline from the design doc through eighteen months of production. I made three design calls. First, six append-only streams, one per record type, so each has its own offset and none blocks the others. Second, a composite-key MERGE at every stage, so a re-delivered file or a re-run task can't double-count. Third, two validation functions that send every mismatch to an error log instead of dropping it, plus a single feature flag that doubles as a kill switch, so I could stop it with one UPDATE and no deploy. Because I was on-call for it, I shipped about a dozen hardening PRs after real failures. It processed about twenty-two million Amex transactions in its first six months, and it's the largest change I've merged, around 1,800 lines. The part I'm proudest of: when it breaks, it records the problem instead of losing data.

full.example: I owned the Amex pipeline end to end, from the design doc through eighteen months of production.

full.zh: 闭环（网络自己同时是发卡方和收单方）
full.example: Amex is a closed-loop network, so we only learn a transaction settled when its daily file arrives.
My rule was that the pipeline never silently drops a record; every mismatch goes to an error log.

hook.example: The pipeline handled on the order of twenty-two million Amex transactions in the first six months.
It has been in production for eighteen months and I was on-call the whole time.
I only give the ballpark: about a dozen hardening PRs and one 1,800-line PR.

starl.zh: 幂等（重复执行结果不变）
starl.example: The composite-key MERGE makes every stage idempotent, so a re-delivered file can't double-count.
One feature flag doubles as a kill switch: a single UPDATE stops the pipeline without a deploy.
I designed it to fail safe: bad rows land in an error log instead of vanishing.

followups.example: The trade-off of staying inside Snowflake was weaker orchestration, which I covered with monitoring and alerts.
A misaligned batch logs one error and self-heals on the next run.
After each real failure I shipped a hardening PR, about a dozen in total.

relp.example: Nobody assigned the EU extension to me; I took end-to-end ownership of it.
Three layers of correctness checks raised the bar for what we call a settled fee.
I traced the late-file problem to the root by reading the load history instead of a dashboard.

senior.q: How would you know the pipeline is correct in production, beyond the tests?
senior.why: 面试官在探：你有没有把正确性做成持续运行的信号，而不只是上线前的测试。
framework: 先说分层：行级（坏字段不炸整批）、批级（每笔结算交易都有费用）、对账级（费用总额对 Amex 自己发的汇总记录）
再说失败时的动作：对账不一致就停 task 并 page on-call，而不是继续往下游放
最后说监控：Streamlit 任务监控加 Datadog 告警，让不一致能被人看见
senior.best_practice: 单靠上线前测试证明不了生产里的数据是对的，因为输入是对方每天发来的文件，随时会变。把校验放在数据流里、并且对账不一致时主动停下来，错误就不会扩散到出款。分层则让你一眼知道是哪一层出了问题，缺哪层补哪层。

terms.zh: 纵深防御（多层校验互相兜底）
terms.example: Row, batch and reconciliation checks gave us defense in depth on fee correctness.

terms.en: reconcile against the source of truth
terms.zh: 对照权威数据源做对账
terms.example: We reconcile fee totals against the summary record Amex itself sends.

senior.q: How would you make adding a seventh record type cheap?
senior.why: 面试官在探：你是否能看出自己设计里的重复，并给出可扩展的方案。
framework: 先承认现状：六个 procedure 把同一份偏移表重复了六次
再说改法：偏移配置表加一个通用的定宽解析，新增记录类型就是加一行配置
最后说验证：用同一批历史文件跑新旧解析，结果逐行对得上才切换
senior.best_practice: 重复的偏移表意味着每加一种记录就要复制一个 procedure，出错面也跟着翻倍。把差异收敛成数据（配置行），通用逻辑只维护一份，扩展成本和风险都会下降。后来我在 quality-check 框架里正是用了这个模式。切换前用历史文件做新旧比对，是为了让重构本身不引入新的钱的错误。

terms.example: Next time I would make the parser config-driven so a new record type is one row.

terms.zh: 用历史数据做回归比对
terms.example: Before switching I would regression-test the generic parser against historical files.

senior.q: What is the blast radius if this pipeline produces a wrong fee, and how do you contain it?
senior.why: 面试官在探：你对出错影响面的意识，以及止损手段是否事先设计好。
framework: 先说影响链：费用计算的输出会喂给出款，所以错误会变成真实的钱
再说止损：feature flag 一条 UPDATE 就能急停，不需要发版
再说留痕：不匹配进 error log，所以能知道受影响范围并更正
最后说事后：已经被下游消费的错误要走更正分录，而不是悄悄改回去
senior.best_practice: 止损手段必须在出事之前就存在：急停要快（不依赖发版），范围要可知（error log 留痕）。下游已经消费的错误状态不能回滚，只能用更正记录补上，这样账目才有可追溯的历史。

terms.zh: 爆炸半径（出错的影响范围）
terms.example: The kill switch let me shrink the blast radius to minutes, not a release cycle.
For fees already consumed downstream, we issue a correcting entry rather than rewriting history.

senior.q: How would you hand this pipeline to another team so it does not depend on you?
senior.why: 面试官在探：你能不能让自己建的东西脱离个人，变成团队可运维的资产。
framework: 先说文档：设计文档、runbook，区分哪些告警是下一轮会自愈的噪音
再说可观测：监控页和告警让别人不用读代码也能判断状态
再说演练：让别人在我旁观下处理一次真实告警
最后说验证：看别人能否在不问我的情况下接入或排查
senior.best_practice: 一条管线只有在别人不问你也能运维和扩展时才算交付完成。runbook 把你脑子里的经验固化下来，监控让状态可见，演练则检验这两样是否真的管用。这样 on-call 才不会永远只有一个人。

terms.zh: 巴士系数（多少人离开会让项目停摆）
terms.example: I would raise the bus factor by getting a teammate to handle a real alert from my runbook.
The runbook separates noisy errors that self-heal from the ones that need a human.
